hero.summary: MAWT is a Geneva-based AI and engineering agency. We design and build custom systems that automate operational workflows for SMEs and growing companies in Switzerland. We write the code that connects your data to production-ready AI.
hero.statement: We create experiences for the world's most ambitious thinkers.

clients.title: Trusted by teams in Geneva & Switzerland

story: Everyone tells you AI will change everything.
But for most businesses, the reality is a mess of disconnected tools and manual workflows.
Slide decks pile up, but the execution layer to turn concepts into software is missing.
Because AI is only a promise. Your business requires systems.
Value is only created when technology is built deep into the core of how you operate.

vision.statement: We turn scattered operations into connected systems that are easier to run, measure, and scale.
